capabilities: encrypt selected text via a command
encrypt entire files via a command
view and edit decrypted content in memory without writing to disk
decrypt externally with the age CLI
extras: Carries a prominent no-warranty caution; warns that losing the passphrase means permanent data loss, that secrets may be synced before decryption, and that regular backups are recommended.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as plain local Markdown files, so sensitive content sits unencrypted on disk and in sync targets.

relations.evidence: Compatible with age CLI tool for external decryption

summary: Encryption plugin that encrypts whole notes or selected text with the age encryption format and keeps decrypted content in memory only.
